evidence.description: Distinct shape_hash values per dataset exceed one across recent probe cycles. The BNM API returns structurally different row sets, while the per-cycle change is not surfaced in a public release artifact.

impact_on_claim_or_decision: Downstream agents that pin a shape_hash for record validation would falsely invalidate matching on the next cycle.
resolution_or_quarantine: Source-card known_quirks documents this; probes mark anomaly_detected=True.
rule_or_policy_change: Probe rule emits shape_hash and anomaly_detected. This corpus retains ground truth for future responders.

regression_test.description: Verifier requires more than one shape_hash across the recorded history.
